editors.name: Afterglow Garden Tiles
editors.notes: Codes 128-138: moonlit ground, wind tuft, vine, four flower quadrants and four hedge quadrants. Flowers and hedges are 2x2 tiles; preserve each four-tile group when changing their silhouettes.

editors.name: Afterglow Pulsing Light
editors.notes: Three 16x16 pulse phases shared by the white live glow and the cyan/magenta echoes. Runtime colors come from DrawActors; spriteColor is only the editor preview color.
